exceptions.reason: The file is the style sheet of a fixture of the tests of the interaction hooks of Base UI. `src/popup/` and `src/list/` replace those hooks.

`src/popup/focus.ts` replaces the file: the initial focus, the trap of a modal popup and the return of the focus. `src/popup/layer.ts` makes the page outside a modal popup inert. Each popup family tests the focus in its own test file, and `src/popup/owner.test.ts` tests the element that owns the popup. The cases of `JSDOM-only coverage` that keep the place of Tab after the trigger leaves run only in JSDOM, where a Tab of the test library starts at `<body>`. The file of Base UI has no code that keeps that place. In a browser, the next Tab starts at the sequential focus navigation starting point of the browser.

exceptions.title: excludes display: contents candidates when checkVisibility is unavailable
exceptions.reason: Each browser of the floor has `checkVisibility()` (Baseline Widely available), so `tabbable` has no path for a browser without it.

exceptions.title: finds adjacent controls around a non-tabbable anchor in a %s tree
exceptions.reason: Vase UI has no `getTabbableNearElement`: no part moves the focus to the tab stop beside an element. The case "leaves out an element with a negative tabindex in a %s tree" keeps the half that `tabbable` covers.
